# Ember Link 0.3.8-dev.1

Development prerelease for testing self-service cloud enrollment.

- Adds USB enrollment tickets and on-device generation of private cloud credentials for fresh DIY devices.
- Preserves a staged identity across interrupted requests and reboots, and prevents enrollment from overwriting an existing cloud identity.
- Adds specific setup errors and safe cached progress while HTTPS requests are in flight.
- Displays "Not linked to an account" for an unclaimed device and clarifies which settings factory reset preserves.

Requires matching enrollment endpoints and browser integration; production Ember setup does not yet implement this new flow. Existing configured devices retain the existing account-linking and cloud protocols.

Finish or reconcile a pending enrollment before downgrading. Older firmware does not understand its recovery journal. Account removal is a separate backend action; factory reset does not remove account ownership.

Uses the established production update signing key and link-v1 layout for the LILYGO T-Dongle-S3. Stable remains on 0.3.7. Qualification evidence is recorded separately for this exact signed image; this is not a stable release or a claim of broad machine compatibility.
